mapper.select: SELECT id, version, remark, state, url, upload_time, instance_id, audit_type, effect_date, file_effect_date, create_by AS createBy FROM bm_operate_rule_version where is_deleted = 0 and operate_id =#{parentId} order by create_time desc

SELECT rule.id as operateId, rule.`code`, rule.`name`, version.id, version.audit_type, version.version, version.upload_time, version.remark, version.state, version.url, version.instance_id, version.effect_date, version.file_effect_date, rule.category_id AS categoryId FROM bm_operate_rule AS rule JOIN bm_operate_rule_version AS version ON rule.id = version.operate_id WHERE rule.is_deleted = 0 AND version.is_deleted = 0 AND version.id = #{id}

SELECT version.* FROM bm_operate_rule AS rule JOIN bm_operate_rule_version AS version on rule.id = version.operate_id where rule.is_deleted = 0 and version.is_deleted = 0 and version.state = 'valid' and rule.id =#{ruleId}

SELECT rule.`code`, rule.`name`, version.id as versionId, version.audit_type, version.version, version.remark, version.effect_date, version.instance_id as processInstanceId, version.id, version.create_by FROM bm_operate_rule AS rule JOIN bm_operate_rule_version AS version ON rule.id = version.operate_id WHERE rule.is_deleted = 0 AND version.is_deleted = 0 and version.`state` = 'audit'
and version.id in
#{versionId}
and rule.`name` like concat('%',#{dto.name},'%')
and rule.`code` like concat('%',#{dto.code},'%')
